data.name: Chief Surgeon Simulator
data.detailed_description:
A genre-blending simulation experience where players become both a hands-on surgeon and the strategic leader of a major hospital. Chief Surgeon Simulator puts your skill and strategy to the test in a high-pressure world where every decision — from incisions to infrastructure — matters.

From the moment patients walk through the door, players oversee every step of their journey: triage, diagnosis, and, when necessary, first-person surgery. Meanwhile, you’ll grow your hospital into a leading institution by managing staff, expanding departments, and investing in cutting-edge care and equipment.

“I enjoyed the opportunity to offer feedback on the Chief Surgeon Simulator’s surgical design,” said noted surgeon Dr. T.F. D'Amore of Marin County, CA. “I worked with the development team to ensure the procedures feel authentic without overwhelming players, striking a thoughtful balance between realism and fun.”

Choose between two game modes: a structured, narrative-driven Story Mode, or a flexible, open-ended Sandbox Mode where creativity and efficiency are your only limits.

 

Key Features:

·     Dual Role Gameplay

·     Perform surgeries and manage a thriving hospital — a hybrid simulation like no other.

·     Authentic Surgical Procedures

·     Diagnose patients, assign staff, or perform real-time operations designed with real-world surgeon input.

·     Full Hospital Oversight

·     Hire doctors, train them, expand departments, and upgrade your facility as you grow your reputation.

 

Two Game Modes

·     Story Mode: Follow a dramatic narrative across structured missions and evolving challenges.

·     Sandbox Mode: Build and manage your hospital with complete creative freedom.

 

Reputation System

·     Deliver great care to earn glowing reviews, which impact funding, upgrades, and growth.

                                               Scrub In and Take Command
Chief Surgeon Simulator Merges High-Stakes Surgery with Hospital Management

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: A dedicated GPU is required. Integrated graphics are not supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended. Game uses Unreal Engine 5 technologies like Lumen and Nanite.
